recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-17116 unless a future terminology QA check reports a new CodeSystem.valueSet mismatch.
issue_request: FHIR-17116 was a Published/Persuasive Vocab change request from STU3. It reported that CodeSystem http://hl7.org/fhir/marital-status declared http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/marital-status as its all-codes ValueSet even though that explicit ValueSet was composed from v3 MaritalStatus, and asked to fix the value set and have the publisher cross-check for similar conflicts.
initial_application: The specific marital-status conflict was already removed before the Jira-tagged FHIR-17116 commit: git 6fc4d35729 deleted source/terminologies/codesystem-marital-status.xml for FHIR-16319 because it was unused and redundant. The Jira-tagged application commit 6296a48a54 (svn 14786) then added CodeSystem.valueSet validation and removed other invalid CodeSystem.valueSet links.
additional_context: Related Published PA issues FHIR-16319, FHIR-16516, and FHIR-17462 all support removal of the obsolete FHIR-defined marital-status CodeSystem because the active marital-status ValueSet uses the v3 MaritalStatus code system, with NullFlavor UNK as needed. Current source contains no reference to the former http://hl7.org/fhir/marital-status CodeSystem URL or codesystem-marital-status file; Patient and Person remain bound to the explicit ValueSet/marital-status, whose source composes from terminology.hl7.org CodeSystem/v3-MaritalStatus and v3-NullFlavor.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current build source no longer has the conflicting CodeSystem.valueSet assertion, and the remaining marital-status ValueSet/bindings reflect the later resolved issue family.
